name: Sikadur®-33

breadcrumb.name: Epoxy Repair Mortars and Rigid Bonding

tagline: High Modulus, High-Strength, Structural, Rapid Curing Epoxy, Smooth-Paste Adhesive
summary: Sikadur-33 is a 2-component, 100% solids, moisture-tolerant, high-modulus, high-strength, structural, smooth-paste epoxy adhesive.
metaDescription: Sikadur-33 is a 2-component, 100% solids, moisture-tolerant, high-modulus, high-strength, structural, smooth-paste epoxy adhesive.
attributes: Can be used on damp concrete
usage: Mortar, Bricks, Blocks, Masonry, render etc.
Interior, vertical and overhead repair of:
Fixing and fastening of handrails, railings, balustrades and supports
Fixing of window and door frames
advantages: Can be used on damp concrete
packaging: 2.7 kg kit (2 litres) 27 kg kit (20 litres)

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text:
Adhesive for structural bonding tested according to EN 1504-4, provided with the CE-mark
Potable Water approved to AS4020:2018 - Testing of products for use in contact with drinking water.
Qld Roads (TMR) Section 5. Registered and Conforming Products. Part 5.18 Epoxy paste for Bearing Installation

items.label: Composition
items.text: Epoxy resin

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months from date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +10 °C and +30 °C. Protect from direct sunlight.

items.label: Density
items.text: 1.35 kg/l (component A+B mixed) (at +23 °C)

items.label: Compressive strength
items.text:
Curing time | Curing temperature +23 °C
1 day | ~30 N/mm2
7 days | ~40 N/mm2
14 days | ~43 N/mm2
14 days | ~50 N/mm2

items.label: Tensile strength in flexure
items.text:
Curing time | Curing temperature +23 °C
14 days | ~20 N/mm2

items.label: Tensile strength
items.text:
Curing time | Curing temperature +23 °C
14 days | ~13 N/mm2

items.label: Tensile adhesion strength
items.text:
Curing time | Substrate | Adhesion strength
3 days | Dry concrete | >5 N/mm2*
3 days | Dry concrete | >5 N/mm2*
3 days | Blastcleaned steel | >10 N/mm2
3 days | Dry brick | >1.5 N/mm2**
*100% concrete failure
**100% brick failure

items.label: Shrinkage
items.text: Hardens without shrinkage

items.label: Coefficient of thermal expansion
items.text: 9.3 x 10−5 per °C (Temp. range +23 °C − +60 °C) | (EN 1770)

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: Component A : component B = 1 : 1 by volume

items.label: Layer thickness
items.text: 0.5 mm min. / 10 mm max.

items.label: Sag flow
items.text: Non-sag, suitable for overhead applicaiton

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +35 °C max.

items.label: Relative air humidity
items.text: 85% max. (at 25 °C)

items.label: Dew point
items.text: Beware of condensation. Substrate temperature during application must be at least 3 °C above dew point.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text: +10 °C min. / +35 °C max.

items.label: Substrate moisture content
items.text: Substrate must be dry or mat damp (no standing water)

items.label: Pot Life
items.text: 60 minutes (+23°C)

items.label: Open Time
items.text:
Temperature | Open Time Tgel
+10 °C | 210 minutes
+20 °C | 90 minutes
+35 °C | 45 minutes
Minimum cartridge temperature +10 °C

items.label: Curing time
items.text:
Temperature | Curing Time Tcur
+10 °C | 3 days*
+20 °C | 2 days*
+35 °C | 1 day*
*To achieve approx. 80% of the performance
Minimum cartridge temperature +10 °C

items.label: Consumption
items.text: ~1.35 kg/m2 per mm of thickness. This figure is theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level or wastage etc.

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: Mortar and concrete must be older than 28 days. Adequate substrate strength (concrete, masonry, natural stone) must always be confirmed.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Pre-mix each component. Proportion equal parts by volume of Component „B‟ and Component „A‟ into a clean pail. Mix thoroughly for 3 minutes with Sika paddle on low speed (400-600 rpm) drill until uniform in colour. Mix only the quantity that can be used within its potlife.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Uncured material may be cleaned from application tools, etc. by using Sika Colma Cleaner (flammable solvent). Cured material can only be removed mechanically.
